descriptions.preferred: Acer Shirasawanum 'Aureum' - 金隐与Acer Shirasawanum 'Kin Kakure' - 金隐笠为异名同株，金隐被认为是欧洲 的品种，而金隐笠被认为是日本的品种；其实两者是 完全一样的。 Acer Shirasawanum 'Kin Kakure' - 金隐 笠曾一度被认为是大叶羽团扇的品种 Acer Japonicum 'Kin Kakure', 在 Japanese Maples 日 本 枫 树 第 二 版 中 J. D. Vertrees 正式改为 Acer Shirasawanum。 金隐叶大且圆，春天新叶为绿色，而后叶色越来越黄， 夏季变为黄绿色，夏季在足够的晨光照射下，会有紫 红色的叶边，秋季为橙红色。 团扇系列，生长速度较慢， 不耐晒，高温天午后遮阴，全日照会出现严重的日灼 现象，成年株可达 3 米左右高度。

sources.name: Aureum Full Moon Japanese Maple
sources.description: The Aureum Full Moon Maple, also known as the Full Moon Japanese Maple, is a stunning tree renowned for its unique golden-yellow foliage and graceful, rounded shape. Unlike other maples, its large, palmate leaves create a broad, full canopy, providing a striking contrast to the more finely dissected leaves of other Japanese Maples. The vibrant gold of the Aureum’s leaves adds a touch of brightness to your landscape, especially during the spring and summer months. In autumn, the tree transitions to brilliant shades of yellow and orange, ensuring year-round beauty. Typically reaching heights of 3 to 4 meters, the Aureum Full Moon Maple is perfect for medium to large gardens or as a specimen tree. It thrives in well-drained soil and partial shade, making it an easy-to-care-for addition to your garden. At Herter Nursery, we offer healthy, robust AureumFull Moon Maples for sale to bring a vibrant pop of colour and a unique form to your outdoor space.

rhs.description: A bushy, slow-growing medium-sized deciduous shrub or small tree. Leaves rounded with 7-9 lobes, bright yellow throughout the summer. Flowers crimson, carried in upright clusters. One of the best yellow-leaved Japanese maples

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 一种丛生、生长缓慢的中型落叶灌木或小乔木。 叶片近圆形，具 7–9 裂，整个夏季保持鲜亮黄色。 花深红色，直立成簇开放。 是黄色叶日本枫中最优秀的品种之一。
